FETCH_WORKERS.description: How many page checks can run at the same time. Higher values can monitor large watch lists faster but use more memory and network bandwidth.

MINIMUM_SECONDS_RECHECK_TIME.description: Shortest allowed time, in seconds, between checks for a watch. Keep this above zero to avoid accidentally hammering websites.

HIDE_REFERER.description: Prevent monitored websites from seeing the changedetection.io address in the HTTP Referer header.

DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK.description: Stop changedetection.io from checking upstream for newer versions. Lawn manages the installed app version through this template.

LOGGER_LEVEL.description: How much detail changedetection.io writes to its logs.

TZ.description: Timezone used for watch schedules and timestamps.

LC_ALL.description: UTF-8 locale used by the application process.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL used in RSS links and notifications. Auto-configured from the Lawn hostname when available.

USE_X_SETTINGS.description: Respect reverse proxy headers such as forwarded host and scheme.

SOCKETIO_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Allowed Socket.IO origins for realtime UI updates through Lawn's local proxy.

FETCH_WORKERS.description: Maximum number of page checks that can run in parallel.

MINIMUM_SECONDS_RECHECK_TIME.description: Minimum number of seconds allowed between checks for a watch.

HIDE_REFERER.description: Hide the changedetection.io URL from monitored websites.

set-password-info.content: changedetection.io starts without a password. Open **Settings** after first launch and set a password before sharing access beyond your own Mac.
